blocks.prompt: 7. Given a signal represented by \(Q(t) = t^3 - 6t^2 + 11t - 6\), determine if the system response is zero at \(t = 4\). If so, identify the factor.
blocks.explanation:
\(t = 4\) par system ka response \(Q(4)\) hai. Factor Theorem kehta hai ke yeh zero tab hi hoga jab \(t - 4\) factor ho.
Find kya karna hai? Haan ya na; agar haan to factor batana hai.
Plan: \(Q(4)\) nikalein; zero aaye to factor \(t - 4\), warna koi factor nahi.
Yeh sawal Question 5 (ii) jaisa hi hai, sirf polynomial aur value badli hai. Ek baar tareeqa samajh liya to aise saare sawal ek hi saanche mein hal hote hain: value nikalo, zero se compare karo, faisla likho.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(Q(t) = t^3 - 6t^2 + 11t - 6\), input \(t = 4\).
Humein find karna hai: kya \(Q(4) = 0\)? Agar haan to factor.
Tareeqa: Factor Theorem: \(t - 4\), \(Q(t)\) ka factor hai agar aur sirf agar \(Q(4) = 0\).

\(Q(4)\) nikalein
\[Q(4) = 4^3 - 6(4)^2 + 11(4) - 6\]
\[= 64 - 6(16) + 44 - 6\]
\[= 64 - 96 + 44 - 6\]
\[= 6\]
Kyun: Pehle powers: \(4^3 = 64\), \(4^2 = 16\). Phir multiply: \(6 \times 16 = 96\), \(11 \times 4 = 44\). Phir baen se daen: \(64 - 96 = -32\), \(-32 + 44 = 12\), \(12 - 6 = 6\).
Dhyan dein: \(64 - 96\) negative hai (\(-32\)); is sign ko sambhal kar aage le jayein.
Ek aur tareeqa: \(Q(4)\) ko nested shakal mein bhi nikal sakte hain, \(((4 - 6)4 + 11)4 - 6 = (3)4 - 6 = 6\). Yeh bilkul synthetic division wale numbers hain.

Natija nikalein
\[Q(4) = 6 \neq 0\]
Kyun: Response 6 hai, zero nahi. Is liye \(t - 4\) factor nahi, aur "identify the factor" wala hissa lagu hi nahi hota.
Jab jawab "nahi" ho to bhi poora jumla likhein: "Since \(Q(4) = 6 \neq 0\), \(t - 4\) is not a factor." Sirf "No" likhne par poore marks nahi milte, kyunke wajah dikhana zaroori hai.

Synthetic division se tasdeeq (\(a = 4\))
Coefficients \(1,\ -6,\ 11,\ -6\):
1 neeche utarein; \(1 \times 4 = 4\), \(-6 + 4 = -2\);
\(-2 \times 4 = -8\), \(11 - 8 = 3\);
\(3 \times 4 = 12\), \(-6 + 12 = 6\).
\[\text{Remainder} = 6 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Wahi remainder 6. Hamari taraf se ek dilchasp baat: \(Q(1) = 1 - 6 + 11 - 6 = 0\), \(Q(2) = 0\), \(Q(3) = 0\), yani \(Q(t) = (t - 1)(t - 2)(t - 3)\). Cubic ke zyada se zyada teen zeros hote hain, is liye \(t = 4\) par zero ho hi nahi sakta tha.
Khud sochiye: agar sawal \(t = 3\) poochhta to jawab kya hota? (Haan, factor \(t - 3\).)
blocks.final_answer: Nahi. \(Q(4) = 6 \neq 0\), is liye \(t = 4\) par response zero nahi aur \(t - 4\) factor nahi hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Answer key (PDF 307) mein is sawal ka jawab number 8 par hai: "System response in not zero when \(t = 4\)" ("in" asal mein "is" hai). Yeh hamare hal se milta hai; key ke number is liye khisak gaye ke us mein 10 jawab hain aur sawal 7.
